result.reason: The Licensor indemnity substantially reaches the preferred position: it covers third-party IP claims, breach of law, Licensor-caused data breaches, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, includes affiliates, and provides defense procedures. However, Licensee's indemnity is not limited to Licensee-provided content and breach of law; it also covers use in material breach of license restrictions. The opening sentence also leaves Licensee broadly responsible for any commercial or legal liability arising from exercise of the license rights, creating an allocation broader than the playbook permits. The fallback is not met either because the clause lacks the usual IP exclusions and remedies and uses a complete liability-cap carveout rather than a 3× annual-fees super-cap. Drafting is generally professional, but the broad opening allocation and uncertain application of the procedures to both parties create avoidable ambiguity.
